methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this investigation is to determine which energy sources should form part of an energy management system aimed at improved profitability.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Descriptive energy-source and cost-distribution case study that recommends adopting an ISO 50001 energy-management framework; it presents no EnPI/EnB measurement model that can be identified and characterised (no normalisation variables, no energy-baseline model, no energy performance indicator relating energy use to a driver). Energy is only inventoried by source (coal tonnes converted to kWh via calorific value) and split by consumption/cost share.

paper_type.evidence_quote: compares it to the energy cost distribution of a South African cement plant by means of a case study

stage1.notes: Cement plant = continuous-process sector; would be Corpus-B relevant IF eligible, but no EnPI/EnB model. Flag for human FN-census / Tier-1 review.
